Name: Penny's New Look - Content Pack
Author: Branic
Description:
REQUIRES: ContentPatcher v1.4+, SMAPI v2.6+

This is a content pack conversion of the 'Penny's New Look' xnb mod by ARModding. It utilizes the ContentPatcher mod by Pathoschild.

Original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2610]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2610[/url]﻿

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
